title: Helm chart: with `installCRDs=false` the cert-controller now runs `--enable-partial-cache` and ignores unlabelled CRDs

detection.reason: CRD labels are not in the CRD projection the rules read

quote: chore: fix enable cache being removed on installCRD=false
remediation: Before 2.9 a release with `installCRDs: false` ran the cert-controller without `--enable-partial-cache`. From 2.9 it is on by default (`certController.enablePartialCache: true`), and the cert-controller only reconciles CRDs labelled `external-secrets.io/component: controller`: an unlabelled ESO CRD never gets its conversion CA injected and the cert-controller's readiness check never passes. If the CRDs named come from elsewhere (a repackaged bundle, GitOps-managed CRDs), label them, or set `certController.enablePartialCache: false`.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.group == "external-secrets.io") | select(.metadata.labels["external-secrets.io/component"] != "controller") | .metadata.name'  # each row is an ESO CRD without the label the partial cache selects

title: `templateFrom[].target` for a Secret target must be Data, Annotations or Labels; the controller now enforces it too

detection.reason: read from the agent's templateFromTargets[] (an empty target is projected as Data); a non-Secret target.manifest may use other targets, and a letters-only target other than type / immutable / metadata / stringData is not matched

quote: chore(fix): template abuse for secret values
remediation: On the ExternalSecrets named whose target is a Secret, change every `spec.target.template.templateFrom[].target` to `Data`, `Annotations` or `Labels` (or remove it) before upgrading. From 2.9 the webhook refuses any other target and the controller re-checks it on every sync, so an existing ExternalSecret that wrote a dotted path (`metadata.ownerReferences`, `type`, …) stops syncing.
verifyCommand: kubectl get externalsecrets.external-secrets.io,clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | [(.spec.target.template.templateFrom // .spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template.templateFrom // [])[].target // ""] | map(select(test("^(|Data|Annotations|Labels)$"; "i") | not)) | select(length != 0) | . as $t | $o | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name) targets=\($t | join(","))"'  # each row writes a templateFrom target the 2.9 controller refuses
coversNotes: v2.9.0 (General): chore(fix): moved the validation further up the chain
